title: ODRE decision-agreement report (bead sq-i6du2.8)
description: The ledger produced by bench/ac/odre/run.sh. A report is COMPLETE when every corpus case appears exactly once with a verdict, every disagreement carries a divergence classification drawn from the ledger, and every agreement figure is either computed from run output or null. agreement.py validates a produced report against this schema before the gate runs, so an incomplete report fails the lane rather than being published.

status.description: complete = ODRE ran and every case has a real verdict. skipped-no-odre = the pinned ODRE implementation was not importable; the report is still complete in shape, every case is SKIPPED, and no agreement figure is stated.

harness_interventions.description: Every deviation from feeding both systems identical bytes, with the reason it was necessary. An empty list would itself be a claim.

coverage.description: Per ODRL construct: how many corpus cases use it, what ODRE DECLARES about it, and what this run OBSERVED. Declared and observed are separate columns on purpose.

encodings.description: Per-encoding tallies. agreement_rate is null unless it was computed from a real ODRE run over a non-empty comparable set.

non_vacuity.description: Per encoding, over the COMPARED cases only: how many policies ODRE was given with at least one rule / at least one constraint, and how its decisions split allow-vs-deny. An agreement rate whose comparable set never gave ODRE a constraint to evaluate, or never drew a deny out of it, is weak evidence and this block is what makes that visible.

ledger_matches.description: Per known-divergences.json entry: its class, the evidence it DECLARES, and how many divergences in this run matched it. An entry declared `source-read` with zero matches remains an unconfirmed prediction.

verdicts.description: One entry per encoding. verdict is the comparison outcome; divergence is present iff verdict == disagree or odre-error.

unclassified.description: Divergences no ledger entry explains. A non-empty list FAILS the run (exit 3) — this is the invariant the bead names.

claims.description: The exact claims this report supports, stated in prose so no reader has to infer them from the numbers.
